notes.title: Animalistic Update 5/10/23
notes.content:
Hey everyone! Thanks for playing my game. Since it's release, I've compiled a list of notes/suggestions and updated - 

[list]
[*] Improved the overall Animalstic effect, made it more satisfying to use and more helpful to the player
[*] Made the Animalistic icon throb when your powerup is primed
[*] Made it impossible to backtrack and cheese the Boar Boss
[*] Made navigating all UI menus easier with an XBOX controller (the right face button now goes BACK)
[*] Various quality-of-life improvements
[*] A TON of LOD improvements/optimization. The game should run much smoother now!
[/list]

Stay tuned for more updates soon!

Happy playing,
Keaton
aka AppleBomb Games

notes.title: Animalistic Full Release OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
The update for Animalistic's full release is complete and released now!!

I can't wait for you all to experience it. This update features -

1. New guns
2. New maps
3. Optimization/Bug fixes
4. An endless wave mode with 4 maps (adding more soon)

6. Various gameplay fixes
7. And a ton of quality-of-life fixes!!
8. A LOT MORE

Happy playing,

notes.title: Animalistic Update 8/28/22
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
With this update, I have increased the radius of punching to make it easier to punch those dang animals. I've also made a few small level improvements pertaining to feedback I've received. 
The bug that wasn't unlocking the achievements for killing the two bosses is squashed. 
Most importantly, I have started the process of adding the much anticipated "Endless Survival" mode. 
Keep an eye out for more! Happy playing,
Keaton
aka AppleBomb Games

notes.title: Animalistic Update 8/6/22
notes.content:
With this patch, I'm fixing a nasty bug where KillZones didn't kill the player properly when falling from a certain height or entering a certain area. Causing the player to get stuck and restart the level on their own.
I'm also fixing a bug that didn't count the players' deaths properly at the end of a level!
Keep an eye out for more! Happy playing,
Keaton
aka AppleBomb Games
